title: Zechariah, Malachi, and Paul’s letters from 1 Corinthians to Ephesians
summary: The last two of the Twelve Prophets, Zechariah and Malachi, and four of Paul’s letters (1 Corinthians, 2 Corinthians, Galatians and Ephesians) are now on the site. Each has a Plain English Translation made from the original languages, study notes, the manuscript differences explained, notes on who it was first written for, and “Where Christians differ” cards. Many older study notes were also updated so their quotations match the new books.
